title: Normalized evaluation adjunction for coefficient systems
statement: Let $Q_Y$ be an algebra tower of modules on a small ringed site and let $Q_X=f^*Q_Y$ for exact ringed pullback $f^*$, with canonical tensor comparison $k$. Use the strict coefficient-system categories, scalar models and projection presentation of [def-sfb-quotient-system-projection-data]. For each positive level $n$, an ordinary evaluation pullback presentation consists of an exact additive functor $F_n:\operatorname{Mod}_{Q_{Y,n}}\to\operatorname{Mod}_{Q_{X,n}}$, an isomorphism $f^*\circ U_{Y,n}\cong U_{X,n}\circ F_n$, a free-module comparison whose underlying map after that isomorphism is exactly $k_{Q_{Y,n},M}$, and an evaluation square $F_n\circ\operatorname{ev}_{Y,n}\cong\operatorname{ev}_{X,n}\circ f_Q^*$ whose underlying map is the inverse restriction comparison. Its derived evaluation square is obtained by exact localization and the canonical derived composition isomorphisms. An evaluation adjunction presentation consists of such ordinary data, a right adjoint $G_n$ to $D(F_n)$, and an isomorphism $\gamma:\operatorname{ev}_{Y,n}\circ G_Q\cong G_n\circ\operatorname{ev}_{X,n}$ normalized by the counit equation: evaluation of the coefficient-system counit equals the inverse evaluation square followed by $D(F_n)(\gamma)$ and the level counit. The evaluated scalar counit is the scalar-model counit followed by the exact evaluation localization isomorphism. This defines data and normalization, asserting no existence.
